plugin.name: NUT UPS
plugin.help: Read-only monitor for one Network UPS Tools (NUT) UPS. Polls its variables and writes them to iHome states.

settingsSchema.name: ups
settingsSchema.label: UPS name
settingsSchema.description: UPS name from ups.conf, e.g. piups.

settingsSchema.name: base
settingsSchema.label: State folder
settingsSchema.description: Relative to iHome (plugins.nut.ups → ihome.0.plugins.nut.ups) or an absolute folder such as 0_userdata.0.nut.

tiles.name: NUT UPS
tiles.description: Battery, runtime, load and status of a Network UPS Tools UPS.
tiles.help: Apply this tile after enabling the plugin. The default sources use the `ihome.0.plugins.nut.ups` base; edit the slot sources if your instance or `base` setting differs.
